I-I'm kidding!
G-geez~... As if I'd ever seriously say
I want you back in the hospital!
(I'm positive she meant every word...)

Now, now, let's put that aside.
Come on, let's hurry to the concert! Let's go!

(I can't have Hoshimura visiting me in that
nurse outfit again. I'd better be careful
never to end up in the hospital...)

(I'm fully recovered now,
so today I'm going to enjoy a concert
at the Sky Gate with Yui!)
Maybe I'll head home now...

Hurry up and get over here, the sea's gorgeous!

You don't have to tell me twice! Here I gooo~!
First one in the sea is gonna be me~!!

...Payback!

We are most well pleased~

rows.en: Okay, even I'm worn out after that...
Sheesh, you're such a wimp~

You're just way too energetic, Hoshimura.
After horsing around that much,
how are you still this full of energy?

'Cause playing with you is so much fun!
All my tiredness just flies right off!

All riiight, let's play some more~!
Race you toward that sun!!
(Seriously, Hoshimura's energy is bottomless...)
Hm? Something wrong, Hoshimura?

Looks like I kinda twisted my ankle...
That I, of all people, should commit
such a blunder... How shameful......
You twisted your ankle...? Are you okay?

Yeah, I'm fine...
I think it'll get better if I rest a bit,
so you go ahead and swim...

What are you talking about?
There's no way I could go off and have fun
and leave you behind injured.
...Sorry.
Come on, this much is only natural.

Besides, a meek Hoshimura like this
is pretty rare, and kinda cute.

Huh...?
Wha? C-cute??
Whaaaaaaaaaaat!!!

No way am I cute!
I'm always tinkering with machines,
and I never bother to dress up or anything!
And, um... uhhh...
*Pshhh~*
Ahaha, just kidding.

Mmph... Don't tease me like that...
Dummy......

(Still, this might be the first time
I've ever seen Hoshimura get embarrassed...)

(So Hoshimura's the type who gets flustered
when someone compliments her straight out.)
Hoshimura, is your ankle okay now?

Zero problemo!
But, well, it's getting late, so shall we
head home?

(There was a little mishap along the way,
but I'm glad I got to have fun with Hoshimura.)

(Plus, I got to see an unexpected side
of Hoshimura.)
